Playbook.name: O365 DLP — High Endpoint DLP Volume by One User (Daily Aggregate) - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: One user generated a high volume (>=200/day) of endpoint/Exchange DLP events - the daily-aggregate replacement for per-event Purview promotion. Triage: heavy-but-legitimate document handling, or data exfiltration by (or via) this user?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: A user moving large volumes of DLP-classified data may be exfiltrating sensitive/regulated information.

Assets.AssetType: Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra directory

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: O365 unified audit via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: event.action, user.name, source.ip, o365.audit.Operation, o365.audit.ResultStatus, o365.audit.ObjectId, o365.audit.ModifiedProperties, o365.audit.Parameters, o365.audit.UserId. INGEST LAG 20-60 min - all queries use a 4h window and timestamp_override event.ingested at rule level.
JCB egress NAT is 94.249.88.0/24 - internal users appear from it.

Signal.Name: High Endpoint DLP Volume by One User (Da

Input.name: $username
Input.description: User with the high DLP volume.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the high DLP volume is legitimate business document handling or data exfiltration.

Step.name: DLP volume, channels and actions for the user
Step.Purpose: The action mix (downloads, network-share copies, uploads) and channels separate normal work from exfil.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.code IN ("DLPEndpoint","ComplianceDLPExchange") AND user.name == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS dlp_events = COUNT(*), actions = VALUES(event.action), channels = VALUES(event.code) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: FileDownloadedFromBrowser/FileCopiedToNetworkShare/FileUploadedToCloud at high volume, especially outside the user's role, suggests exfil. FileModified/normal-app actions suggest routine work. Note the action mix.

Step.name: Is this outside the user's normal pattern
Step.Purpose: A sudden spike vs a consistently high-volume role user distinguishes exfil from a data-heavy job.
Step.Query: FROM logs-o365.audit-* | WHERE event.code == "DLPEndpoint" AND user.name == "$username" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS events = COUNT(*), distinct_actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: Correlate with the user's role - a finance/data analyst may legitimately hit this; a teller/branch user should not. A spike after an account-compromise indicator is exfil.

Node.Condition: High-volume downloads/uploads/network-copies of DLP data outside the user's role, or after a compromise indicator.
Node.Result: True Positive (Data Exfiltration - escalate, involve DLP/compliance)

Node.Condition: A data-heavy role user (analyst/finance) with routine high-volume document handling.
A DLP policy over-classifying benign files, inflating volume.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-O365DLP-VOLUME, INV-02-O365DLP-CONTEXT to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: Routine high-volume document handling by a data-heavy role.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the role/work; close as benign_activity.

TruePositive.Definition: Data exfiltration by or via the user.

SOCAction.Item: Engage DLP/compliance; review the moved data; reset the account if compromised; open IR.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A DLP policy over-classifying benign files.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Confirm the change/actor in the audit log.
If unexpected/unauthorised, disable the actor session and reverse the change.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Reverse the change; revoke sessions/tokens for the actor and affected principals.
Review the actor's other recent audit activity.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Enforce MFA/conditional access; tighten admin consent and privileged-role governance (PIM); alert on these operations.

QualityChecks.Check: Account for O365 ingest lag (20-60 min) - short windows miss events; this rule uses event.ingested override.
Exclude the egress NAT 94.249.88.0/24 where source is used; tune known admin/automation via exceptions.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Exfil scoped with DLP/compliance; account secured; data reviewed.
